artifacts.description: feat(core): own error for a unit change across dimensions

acceptance_criteria: New `ModelError::UnitDimension { param: String, from: String, to: String }`, where `from` and `to` are the old and new unit strings as stored (empty for no unit). `set_param_unit` returns it, not `ParameterDimension`, when the new unit has another dimension. All other `set_param_unit` behaviour from #291 is unchanged, and the document is unchanged on this error.

Its `Display` names the parameter, both units and both dimensions. For `tilt` from `deg` to `mm` it is exactly: ``can't change the unit of `tilt` from deg (angle) to mm (length): they measure different things``. An empty unit is written as `no unit`, and its dimension as `Dim`'s existing `Display` text.
`ParameterDimension` and its message are unchanged for expressions (an existing test asserting that message still passes unmodified).

Unit tests in `swx-core`: `deg`→`mm` (exact message above), `mm`→empty, and empty→`mm` give `UnitDimension` with the right fields, each with `parameters()` unchanged afterwards. The `mm`→`deg` and `mm`→empty assertions in `unit_change_errors_leave_document_unchanged` change from `ParameterDimension` to `UnitDimension`. That is the intended change, not a weakened test.
`cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace` pass.
QA report (FACTORY §6b) posted on the PR.
